# Pandamonium v1.0.36

Friday can now use the workstation's available Codex models and reasoning levels from the project sidebar. Work stays in the selected Codex project and existing task, with the workstation's global and project instructions intact.

## MAD-867 — Friday: restore workstation catalog and expose Codex model selection

### Problem

A workstation service could report Friday as connected even when its PATH could not find the installed Codex executable, leaving the task catalog unavailable. Friday also forced one configured model without a model selector. Project selection could silently fall back to a previous conversation's directory.

### Implementation

The private workstation bridge reports missing executables as unavailable, and its absolute executable setting is documented. Authenticated model discovery uses Codex App Server's model/list API. The sidebar offers the returned models and each model's supported reasoning efforts, and validated selections reach turn/start for new and resumed tasks. Changing the model of an active turn is rejected explicitly. An explicitly selected project cannot silently follow another project's conversation binding.

### Product value and UI visibility

Choose Friday, choose a model and reasoning level above Projects, then select a project and an existing task or use the normal composer for a new task. Codex remains on the workstation and loads its usual global and project AGENTS.md instructions. Existing Whoami bootloaders continue to work without an import, database mirror, or additional model loop.

### Verification

The complete local Python suite passed 5,540 tests with 5 intentional skips. All six Friday Chromium browser tests passed, including model, reasoning, project, and task propagation through the normal composer. Python compilation and diff hygiene passed. A clean authenticated local app retrieved the live workstation's model and project catalogs. A bounded ephemeral gpt-6-astra/medium run confirmed the selected project directory and global/project Whoami startup documents without modifying files or creating a saved Codex conversation.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Update both Pandamonium and the private workstation bridge for model selection. Set JARVIS_CODEX_BIN to an absolute executable path when the service PATH excludes a user-local installation. The workstation project map and web application's workspace aliases must match; public installs retain empty project defaults. The operator's existing desktop projects were configured privately, with no credentials or private project paths included in this release. No dependency or database schema change is required. Model changes apply to subsequent turns; active work must finish first. Use a new conversation or an explicitly selected existing task when changing projects. This release does not resolve the separate Jarvis reasoning-only response/recovery failure tracked in MAD-842.
